headline: Fatal Explosion Reported At Oil Refinery In Blora Central Java
seoTitle: Fatal Oil Refinery Explosion In Blora
metaDescription: A fatal explosion at the PPSDM Migas Cepu refinery in Blora, Central Java, resulted in one death after a worker sustained severe burn injuries.
aiSummaryBullets: An explosion occurred at tank number T 143 at the PPSDM Migas Cepu refinery on Wednesday.
One contract worker died after suffering burns covering 90 percent of his body.
Authorities are investigating the incident, with police suspecting residual gas inside the tank caused the blast.
aiContextParagraph: On November 18, 2026, a major explosion occurred at the PPSDM Migas Cepu oil refinery located in Blora, Central Java. The blast, which local residents described as sounding similar to a crashing airplane, originated from tank number T 143. According to reports from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM), the incident resulted in the death of one third-party contract worker who sustained burns over 90 percent of his body. Police have initiated an investigation into the cause of the explosion, with preliminary suspicions pointing toward residual gas remaining inside the storage tank during maintenance activities. The event has prompted attention from government officials who are currently working to determine the precise sequence of events leading to the fatal accident at the facility.
whyItIsViral: This incident is currently trending due to its rapid coverage by six independent media outlets and a very high velocity of reporting across the region.
